tagline: Independent and neutral representative organization for European inland waterway interests
hero_kpi_rationale: IVR is a non-profit association representing the interests of the European inland shipping sector. The key KPI is annual congress participation (225 participants in 2024 from 11 countries), reflecting the organization's stakeholder engagement and influence within the inland maritime sector.

kpis.name: Annual Congress Participants
kpis.explanation: Number of participants attending the annual IVR Congress from multiple European countries, demonstrating stakeholder engagement and international representation.
kpis.description: The IVR Congress 2024 took place from May 15 to 17 in Frankfurt am Main and welcomed 225 participants from 11 European countries, including representatives from the maritime industry, insurance, and ship inspection sectors.
kpis.signal: Strong stakeholder engagement and international representation

kpis.name: Countries Represented
kpis.explanation: Number of distinct European countries represented at the annual congress and in IVR membership.
kpis.description: The IVR Congress 2024 brought together representatives from 11 different European countries, demonstrating the organization's international reach and balanced sector representation.

kpis.name: Loss Prevention Colloquium Attendees
kpis.explanation: Number of participants at the inaugural Loss Prevention Colloquium organized by IVR, featuring technical and financial aspects of loss prevention in European inland shipping.
kpis.description: The first IVR Loss Prevention Colloquium was held on November 4, 2024 in Antwerp, gathering around 80 participants from Belgium, the Netherlands, and Germany, representing diverse sectors including insurance, brokerage, surveying, and maritime operations.
kpis.signal: Launch of new flagship event with strong professional participation

kpis.name: Published Technical Guidance Documents
kpis.explanation: Number of technical guidance documents and fact sheets published by IVR committees to provide industry with current and relevant information.
kpis.description: Several new technical documents and information sheets were published by IVR committees throughout 2024, providing the inland shipping industry with up-to-date and relevant information on technical standards and loss prevention.
kpis.signal: Ongoing knowledge dissemination and industry guidance through committee initiatives

kpis.name: Revenue
kpis.description: Revenue extracted from yfinance.income_stmt over the last 4 years. Metric tracked annually, historical values maintained over the past 4 years.
kpis.signal: Revenue of €0.7 Bn in the latest year

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of €0.72 Bn in the latest year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of €0.26 Bn in the latest year

kpis.name: Cash & Equivalents
kpis.description: Cash & equivalents extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Cash & equivalents of €0.1 Bn in the latest year

ai_positioning.summary: No mention of artificial intelligence or advanced digital solutions. IVR focuses on traditional areas: regulatory representation, technical standards, loss prevention, and industry knowledge exchange for inland waterway transportation.
evidence: No reference to AI or emerging digital technologies
Focus on regulatory compliance, technical standards (CESNI), and safety
Traditional conference and committee-based organizational model
Discussion of digitalization in inland shipping context limited to professional qualification standards
